checks.requirement: Complete portable C++23 scene/moc/QML/test build closure with latest native Qt
checks.evidence: Top-level C++23 required/no extensions and actual probe cover the new static YalahooScene; Gui/Core and existing motion target are the only dependencies. All four cpp/header sources are explicitly listed and moc runs for both QObject classes. Yalahoo and SceneTest consume the same scene code; foreign uncreatable wrappers expose native owners. GeometryScene alias is module-relative under scene/, generated extra qmldir is included by the qml module, and App imports it from its qrc-relative directory. Review cpp/CLI/three runtime suites are guarded by one opt-in CMake option; default production does not compile the verifier. No platform conditional, undefined symbol, unavailable source or private Qt include in the added render target. Existing APPLE/UNIX compiler and platform branches remain valid; no Windows dependency leaks to this target.
checks.limitations: No macOS/Linux compiler or linker executed. Native Kit discovery and platform deployment continue through existing scripts and later platform rounds.

checks.requirement: Qrc geometry/module resolution, logical-pixel measurements and no private library access
checks.evidence: Native scene lives after motion and before engine, so the engine/render teardown precedes native owner destruction. No render method opens a file or uses cwd/native paths. All three source-preserving meshes resolve the asset manifest qrc aliases, independent of case/Unicode cwd and packaging Resources lookup. Actual window content width/height flow to the single LayoutMetrics; camera aspect/span and QML layout label use the same object, never multiply by DPR. Empty/negative dimensions clamp to 1 and nonfinite inputs are rejected. Cinematic reference coordinates are isolated measurements; View3D fills physical logical content. Windows checked all client dimensions, image sizes and effective DPR rather than only requested environment variables. The only anonymous review fixture is explicit and build-gated, with no user data/index source.
checks.limitations: Bundle/XDG deployment not changed in R06; target native filesystem and live DPR migration between monitors await user tests.

checks.requirement: Right-handed transforms, camera FOV, logical projection and render-backend closure
checks.evidence: SceneFrame uses right-handed Y-up lookAt and perspective; quaternion is extracted from inverse view, with no Euler approximation or global Z flip. Case mesh vertices retain original asset scale, and the sole Node applies translation once. Near=5/far=300 and vertical FOV computed from current distance/span match Three. CPU helper maps GL NDC to top-left logical pixels and ray helper inverts that same matrix and caseTransform. Quick3D owns D3D/Metal/GL clip-space/depth/Y conversion; CPU NDC z is explicitly not a native backend depth value. Scene uses public no-light PrincipledMaterial and existing MSAA/no extra shader or texture capture, normal/depth/transparent sorting pipeline added. Platform API branches in main still select D3D11/Metal/OpenGL separately. Existing actual qsb test inspects MSL/GLSL variants. Windows independent frozen targets/trajectories plus real View3D.mapFrom3DScene and image mesh pixels validate the actual quaternion/camera/render bindings at nine sizes, fractional DPR and moving aspect boundary. No second QML camera constant table.
checks.limitations: MSL/GLSL generation is static only. Metal/OpenGL real projection/rasterization await target checks; no material/SSAO/DOF/output parity or GPU performance claim for this geometric debug scene.

checks.requirement: Single-clock camera dynamics, safe owner lifetime and unchanged media independence
checks.evidence: SceneAdapter connects to the existing owner-context FrameClock signal and consumes only motionDt, never a second speed multiplication. A resize publishes portrait/aspect in the same synchronous LayoutMetrics callback; prior position/aim/span and spring velocities survive until rate=9 updates. No product QTimer, elapsed clock, network/provider request, QProcess, media call or render-thread QObject mutation is introduced. Navigation uses source rate=6, real columns suppress row orbit, reduced motion snaps the current target and resets navigation orbit. Main routes MotionController::reducedMotionChanged to the same SceneAdapter; runtime-motion asserts equal reduced state and settled camera. Scene owner outlives engine and has QObject contextual signal disconnection. Review-only timer acquires already computed deterministic states after three GPU frames; it does not calculate pose from wall time and stops on final state/timeout. Render callback captures a shared atomic counter and disconnects its own connection before exit, preserving counter lifetime even for an in-flight invocation. Existing Windows motion/library/runtime regressions still verify hidden/minimized visual pause and empty media source. Actual playback/device lifecycle remains later R24/R25.
checks.limitations: Full presentation/selected-lease/scene rebuild lifecycle and actual playing audio are outside R06. Target native application visibility delivery is still unexecuted.

checks.requirement: Reproducible frozen source provenance and real Release geometry evidence
checks.evidence: Oracle executes immutable Git functions and actual scene target statements, not a transcribed implementation or runtime screenshot. Source hashes cover viewport/motion/camera/scene/model/spacing; independent Three projects original corners and paper/center anchors. CPU checks 48 targets, 528 points and 694 nonzero/variable-rate interrupted states; Windows real RHI windows render all 48 and each of 361 120fps sampling states for each effective DPR 1/1.5/2. Every logical point must be <=2px from independent Web projection; double position/aim/FOV must be <=1e-6. Script verifies exact client size, real DPR, PNG size, mesh pixels, all cases passed, source/fixture hashes, warning-free qmllint and all 16 Release CTest suites including asset/qsb and old production regression. Each matrix entry records manual actual call/branch trace plus source hashes. No discovered static defect remains in R06.
checks.limitations: Numerical and unlit geometry verification do not establish material/light/UI parity. Windows reports and screenshots are explicitly not macOS/Linux execution evidence.
